steps.en: Notice of a deceased individual is recognised from the MHA result
steps.id: Notice milik individu yang meninggal dikenali dari hasil MHA

steps.en: Suspension is applied right after the status is recognised
steps.id: Suspension langsung diterapkan setelah status dikenali

steps.en: A specific suspension code is used for deceased cases
steps.id: Suspension memakai code khusus untuk kasus meninggal

steps.why_en: The code applies a permanent suspension, not a temporary one.
steps.why_id: Code memakai suspension permanen, bukan sementara.

steps.why_en: No end date is set; the suspension has no period.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada tanggal berakhir; suspension tidak punya masa berlaku.

steps.en: The notice does not escalate to the next stage
steps.id: Notice tidak naik ke stage berikutnya
steps.why_en: Only the suspension is proven; whether every stage job skips it is not verified.
steps.why_id: Hanya pemasangan suspension yang terbukti; semua job stage melewatinya belum diverifikasi.
